# Internal mode build — reconciliation rulings (plan_version 1)

Feature Planner rulings made after the deep-research ticket pass. They **override** anything in `contracts.md` or a ticket that conflicts with them, and `contracts.md` has been updated inline where marked ✎. Each ticket already applies the ruling that concerns it; a worker who finds a conflict follows this file.

## Contract rulings

- **R1 · Browser-safe id helpers (L3) ✎.** `@khala/contracts` runs in the browser (`apps/web` imports it at runtime, e.g. `apps/web/src/composition/human/browser-api.ts:1-5`), where `Buffer` is undefined. KI-110 ships pure `base64url(bytes)` and `hex(bytes)` and builds `newLocalRoomId`/`newLocalAgentUserId`/`newLocalEventId` on them (same names; `RangeError` on a wrong byte length). `localRoomKey` throws on anything that is not `isLocalRoomId` (path-traversal guard).
- **R2 · `LocalCreateContent.operationId?: string` (L3) ✎.** The create content carries the browser's `operationId`, and `decodeLocalEvent` accepts it.
- **R3 · State-dir creation (L2) ✎.** `ensureStateDir` also checks the two parent directories (`packages/agent/src/state.ts:40-46`), and `~/.local/state` is commonly 0755. Call it only on `<stateRoot>/local/channels` (and deeper), never on `<stateRoot>` or `<stateRoot>/local`. KI-122 writes `hosted-profile.json` with its own root-only check.
- **R4 · No writes before bind (L2/L11) ✎.** A second `khala local serve` opens the store before it learns it lost the port, so opening the store writes nothing: the torn last line is truncated just before the next append, and `owner.json` is saved only after the server listens.
- **R5 · Agent device id (L4/L5) ✎.** `deviceId = 'KH_LOCAL_' + <the 8 hex of @agent-<8hex>:local>`; the owner's is `LOCAL_OWNER_DEVICE_ID`. Derived, never stored.
- **R6 · `/me` keeps `invitedBy` (L5) ✎.** `GET …/me` returns `invitedBy` for an agent after it joins too; KI-121 falls back to `LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID` if absent (otherwise every mode command is dropped at `packages/agent/src/client-impl.ts:151`).
- **R7 · Remove = membership `leave` (L6) ✎.** Removing an agent appends `leave` and keeps the token resolvable, so the agent's next call gets `403 not_member` (AE11). Revoking the token would turn that into 401.
- **R8 · Auth failures (L6) ✎.** An agent token on an owner route → `401 {"error":"unauthorized"}`. An unrecognised bearer (e.g. the poll secret on `/api/agent/join/*`) reaches the route as `auth: {kind:'none'}`, not a blanket 401.
- **R9 · `/open` redirect (L6) ✎.** With no room, `/open/<token>` redirects to `/conversations` (`apps/web/src/composition/human/routes.ts:58`); there is no bare `/channels` route.
- **R10 · Profile (L6/L7) ✎.** Username change also appends an owner member event with the new display name in every channel, and bumps the revision (as does every `setOwner`). Rename and username `400` bodies carry `reason: NameError` (the web maps it, `apps/web/src/composition/human/browser-api.ts:448-451`). Initials follow PR #986's rule once merged (exactly two `\p{L}\p{Nd}`, NFC, upper-cased; `null` clears) and `OwnerProfileView.initials` is `string | null`; KI-110/KI-135/KI-140 delegate to #986's reader when it exists at pickup.
- **R11 · Owner fallback name (L10) ✎.** `owner` is a reserved name (`packages/contracts/src/messaging/agent-names.ts:9`), so the last-resort fallback is `LOCAL_OWNER_FALLBACK_NAME = 'User'` (the hosted `suggestUsername` fallback).
- **R12 · Helper-internal additions (L8) ✎.** `member()` returns `Omit<LocalMember,'membership'> & { membership: 'invite'|'join'|'leave' }`. `HelperContext` gains `createOwnerSession(): string` and `shutdown(): void` (KI-137 implements; shutdown deferred ~25 ms so the 204 flushes). `createHelperServer` takes `createContext(origin)` instead of a fixed `ctx` (the port is known only after bind), serves `/healthz` itself, and sends `referrer-policy: no-referrer` on HTML. Pinned signatures: KI-130 (`openLocalStore`, `LocalStoreError`), KI-131 (`createHelperServer`, `LOCAL_CSP`, `LOCAL_OWNER_COOKIE`), KI-136 (`helperPaths`, `helperBinPath`, `helperChildEnv`, `HELPER_ENV_ALLOWLIST`).
- **R13 · Helper child env (L11) ✎.** `ensureHelper` spawns the helper with an allow-listed copy of the caller's env (`HOME`, `PATH`, `XDG_STATE_HOME`, `KHALA_LOCAL_*`, `NODE_OPTIONS`, …; never tokens), so the no-egress guard (KI-151) follows the helper.
- **R14 · CLI errors (L12) ✎.** Codes: `invalid_arguments`, `not_found`, `ambiguous_channel`, `helper_unavailable`, `unsafe_state_dir`, `storage_failed`, `port_in_use` (serve, stderr). Human hints such as `web_not_built` go to stderr; stdout is always one JSON object.
- **R15 · Agent seam details (L9).** The session types are defined in `transport.ts` and re-exported by `matrix/session.ts`. KI-120 lands a pinned placeholder `packages/agent/src/local/session.ts` that throws `local_transport_unavailable` so the lazy import typechecks; KI-121 replaces it. Type-only imports from `./matrix/session` must be statement-level `import type` (with `verbatimModuleSyntax`, an inline `type` specifier still loads matrix-js-sdk); KI-120 adds a source-scan test. The `khala_join` result gains `autoConfirmed?: true` (the only `client.ts` change) and KI-120 rewords the `khala_join` tool description so it no longer says every join needs a confirmation link.
- **R16 · Web seam names (L13) ✎.** `LocalMembersCache` is declared in `composition/local/types.ts` (KI-140) and implemented by `createLocalMembers(http, limits)` (KI-142). `LocalHttp` results carry an optional `reason`, and `get`/`send` take an optional trailing `timeoutMs` (long-polls). Pinned additions: `createLocalSession(...).noteUsername`, `createLocalProfilePort(http, {onUsername})`, `createLocalChannelService({principal, actor, device, substrate, limits, journal?, onObserve?})`, `createLocalConversations(http, {storage, sleep})` with `viewing` and `syncStatus`. KI-143 wires `onObserve → conversations.viewing` and `onUsername → session.noteUsername`. The extraction range is `matrix-browser.ts:466-504` (projection) and `:506-526` (`sendRoomMessage`, payload at `:512-516`). `encodeMessageContent` in `composition/human/message-wire.ts` is unrelated to the contracts function of the same name (`packages/contracts/src/messaging/events.ts:124`); never import both into one module.
- **R17 · Account mode (L13).** KI-144 adds one optional `renderIdentityUnavailable` prop to `screen.tsx` and pins `HumanAccountContext`/`useHumanAccount`; no "Local" badge (minimal labeling; the tab title `Khala · local` set by KI-143 carries the distinction).
- **R18 · Egress log (new L14).** KI-151 pins the `EgressRecord` log line read by KI-160 and KI-161; see KI-151.
